inv.desc_en:
Industrial complex of 8,218 m² distributed as follows:
■ Warehouse/warehouse: 2,801 m²
■ Mezzanine (Exhibition and offices): 1,821 m²
■ 1st floor (Workshop, exhibition and offices): 2,844 m²
■ 2nd floor Offices: 547 m²
■ 3rd floor Offices: 205 m²

■ Industrial warehouse aimed at the Automotive sector
■ Privileged location with very commercial direct visibility from the northern node of Castellana
■ Access gates for vehicles
■ PCI with BIE's
■ Toilets and changing rooms
■ Car lift
■ Offices with A/C installation
■ Independent access to offices
■ Side and rear patios for parking spaces (more than 200)

You can see our complete portfolio of properties by clicking on our AXIS Property logo

Fees charged to the property.

Contact us to learn about our AXIS Architecture services.
